Record Class AlgoMeanReversionScopeEvaluator.Proposal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoMeanReversionScopeEvaluator.Proposal
Record Components:
scope - the strategy and instrument the decision belongs to
idAlgoTop - the hierarchy the instrument was reached through
member - the AlgoSecurity node that carries its weight, null when the allocation could not be resolved and the decision is therefore unavailable
valuationDate - the closing day the decision was taken on, which for an instrument whose exchange was closed is earlier than the day the caller asked for
decision - what to do, including the blocked and unavailable outcomes
context - the inputs the decision was taken from; a caller that books a fill needs it again
securityExposure - gross exposure of the instrument in tenant currency before the decision
amount - size of the proposal in tenant currency, zero when nothing is proposed
unitExposure - tenant currency value of one unit, including the value per point of a margin instrument
Enclosing class:
AlgoMeanReversionScopeEvaluator
public static record AlgoMeanReversionScopeEvaluator.Proposal(AlgoAlertScope scope, Integer idAlgoTop, AlgoSecurity member, LocalDate valuationDate, AlgoMeanReversionDecisionService.Decision decision, AlgoMeanReversionDecisionService.Context context, double securityExposure, double amount, double unitExposure) extends Record
One instrument of one strategy on one closing day, after every budget and ordering rule has been applied.
